args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money

round_money's docstring already specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
per FIN-212, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build (e.g. 2.665 rounded to
2.67 instead of 2.66).

Switch the import and quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so the implementation
matches the documented behavior.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` incorrectly used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

Example of the failure: `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`. The docstring already documented banker's rounding per FIN-212, so the implementation now matches the documented behavior.

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
